text: Make the merge queue prove the exact future squash commit and then install that identical object on main, so no code is rebuilt or reinterpreted after approval.
rationale: Identity between the proved artifact and the merged artifact removes post-proof drift while collapsing duplicate PR and main validation.

text: Compile the proof battery from a typed lane DSL that rejects undeclared filesystem, network, clock, randomness, process, and environment dependencies before any lane can join Yeet.
rationale: Flakiness becomes an invalid pipeline definition instead of a runtime surprise, and hermetic lanes need less defensive setup and cleanup.

text: Issue every agent a base-and-toolchain lease whose expiry makes publication structurally impossible once main, Bun, tsgo, or the lockfile identity changes.
rationale: Stale-clone and stale-proof races disappear at the publication boundary rather than waking someone after hosted CI discovers them.

text: Turn every accepted failure into a repository-owned deterministic reproducer capsule, and forbid a flaky lane from returning to required status until its capsule passes under frozen entropy.
rationale: The pipeline accumulates executable immunity to prior incidents and cannot silently reintroduce nondeterministic gates.

text: Require code generators and agent edit tools to emit proof-obligation manifests alongside patches, with Yeet refusing any syntax hash whose declared architectural laws lack matching witnesses.
rationale: Agents manufacture locally checkable evidence with the change, shifting broad rediscovery work into construction-time obligations.

text: Make main a content-addressed projection of independently verified patch capsules, with atomic pointer promotion and automatic predecessor fallback instead of mutable branch integration.
rationale: A bad integration cannot create a half-red main, and rollback becomes metadata movement rather than an emergency rebuild or revert campaign.
